note: There are THREE regeneration paths in this repo, not two, and make rebaseline-goldens is itself incomplete. The Grain established the first two: regenerate-artifacts.sh (what make rebaseline calls) misses windows/vessel/tests/fixtures, which make rebaseline-goldens covers. Third finding, measured during The Glasshouse terrain epoch: make rebaseline-goldens is an explicit list of SEVEN scoped invocations -- lens_purity, scene golden, proto_goblinoid_golden, architecture, session_snapshot, solitary_tongue, affect_trace_golden -- and hornvale-terrain is not among them. So domains/terrain/tests/fixtures/channel-network-seed-42-level-5.txt is accepted ONLY by REBASELINE=1 cargo test -p hornvale-terrain --test channel_golden, which no make target runs. This produced a false DONE: an implementer ran make rebaseline-goldens, reasonably concluded the channel golden was covered, reported it cleared, and the test was still red on the committed tree. The trap is sharpened by the golden failure message itself, which names REBASELINE=1 or make rebaseline-goldens as if either worked -- only the scoped one does. So after any change that moves river geometry, run the scoped invocation by hand, and never treat a green make rebaseline-goldens as evidence the goldens are current.
